common.limitExceeded: Too many records to show; narrow the filters.
common.conflictBody: The record was updated while you were editing. Load the latest version and redo your changes.

common.saveViewBody: Search, filters and grouping are kept for you in this browser.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.description: Warehouses, their bin structure and stock rules.
warehouses.newBody: You can add locations after saving.
warehouses.deleteFailed: The warehouse could not be deleted.
warehouses.deleteBody: Only warehouses without stock movements can be deleted. Deactivate a warehouse that has moved stock.
warehouses.deleteDefault: The default warehouse cannot be deleted.
warehouses.deleteMoved: A warehouse with stock movements cannot be deleted; deactivate it.
warehouses.defaultHelp: Used when a document names no warehouse. A company has exactly one default warehouse.
warehouses.defaultLocked: This is the default warehouse. Make another warehouse the default to change it.
warehouses.defaultMoves: On save, {{code}} stops being the default.
warehouses.allowNegativeHelp: When on, issues may exceed the stock; a negative balance is not corrected automatically by the next receipt.
warehouses.activeHelp: Inactive warehouses cannot be chosen on new documents; history is kept.

policyHelp.none: No reservations; available equals on hand.
policyHelp.soft: Reservations beyond the available quantity are allowed and reported.
policyHelp.hard: Reservations beyond the available quantity are refused.

locations.deleteFailed: The location could not be deleted.
locations.deleteBody: Locations holding stock or movements cannot be deleted; deactivate them.
locations.emptyBody: Add locations to track stock per shelf or bin.
locations.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to move, right/left to expand or collapse, Enter to edit.
